assets.file-disl:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one actual 32 x 32 pixel-art file sprite for a Space Station 13-inspired terminal UI.
Input image 1 is ONLY a typography style reference: copy its narrow, single-pixel-stroke bitmap letter grammar. Do not reproduce the font chart or its background.
Draw a deliberately simple, flat sprite on a strict 32x32 logical pixel grid, enlarged only with nearest-neighbor square pixels if required. Center an upright 22px-wide, 28px-tall file plaque in the canvas. Shared silhouette: straight vertical sides, absolutely square bottom corners, small 4x4 stair-step folded upper-right corner, one dark-charcoal outer pixel outline, one pale-ivory pixel rim, solid inset type color. The entire sprite uses only five solid colors plus the background: no extra shades. Every contour and marking has hard horizontal/vertical pixel edges; diagonals are explicit one-pixel stairs.
Background: uniform pure #ff00ff chroma key only, including all empty margin; no checkerboard and no shadow. The background will be removed during exact-size import.
This is NOT an illustration of an icon: it IS the tiny game sprite. NO bevels, gradients, gloss, texture, anti-aliasing, round corners, lighting, perspective, cast shadows, blurred edges, microdecoration or extra symbols. The letter strokes and pictograms must remain clean and legible when sampled to 32x32. No labels outside the sprite.

Subject: blue DiSL source-file plaque. Solid inset muted medium blue #426b9a, ivory lettering. ONLY text is two precisely aligned rows: "Di" on the top line and "SL" below it. Capital D, lowercase i, capital S, capital L. Each glyph is narrow 3x7 or 4x7 logical pixels with SINGLE-pixel strokes as in the supplied font chart; same cap height and spacing across both rows. Keep ample blue breathing room around the type. No other lines or icons.
